## Tesla Faces Autopilot Regulatory Questions as UK Sales Fall 9%

TSLA bulls need both strong unit volume and credible AV optionality to justify the multiple; this headline challenges both simultaneously. UK market data is also a leading read on EU regulatory appetite for Tesla autonomy features, making the regulatory angle potentially broader than one market.

- UK Tesla sales declined 9% per headline — a concrete volume data point for a major European market.
- Autopilot is under renewed regulatory scrutiny; nature of the questions and which regulatory body is involved are not specified in coverage.
- Dual headwind: near-term volume weakness and longer-dated AV regulatory risk surfacing in the same story.
- Single outlet (simplywall.st); no detail on whether a formal probe is underway or the scrutiny is informal/media-driven.
